Pinned runBackup returns before repository open for all invalid source roots, but mixed invalid/valid roots continue through snapshot creation and return ErrInvalidSourceData after reporting the snapshot.
The pinned regression test covers helper-level ENOTDIR/NUL cases, not an end-to-end snapshot write.
Pinned Restic check separates structural checks from data reads; n/t partitions apply to the current pack set and random subset passes do not guarantee eventual full coverage.
